October 02, 2026 NRO successfully launches NROL-97 aboard its first SpaceX Falcon Heavy mission The National Reconnaissance Office (NRO), in partnership with U.S. Space Force Space Systems Command’s (SSC), System Delta 80, Space Launch Delta 45, and SpaceX, successfully launched the NROL-97 mission aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket from Launch Complex 39A at Kennedy Space Center in Florida on Oct. 1, at 11:54 p.m. ET.
August 18, 2026 Dr. Roger Mason Sworn in as NRO’s 20th Director
